```javascript
// Pseudo: token validation
function authorize(token, action, tenantId){
  const claims = decodeJWT(token)
  if(!claims.scopes.includes(action)) throw new Error('forbidden')
  if(claims.tenantId !== tenantId) throw new Error('tenant mismatch')
  return true
}
```
